projects.title: SSA Academy
projects.description: SSA (Shoot Soccer Academy) — staff manage player rosters, guardians, invoices, and stats from one dashboard.
projects.overview: Next.js app with Postgres (Prisma): search players, export CSV/JSON, generate invoices, and run the academy back-office. Live at ssa-shoot-score-academy.vercel.app.
highlights: SSA (Shoot Soccer Academy) — staff manage player rosters, guardians, invoices, and stats from one dashboard.

projects.title: Hash-Sec Tunnel
projects.description: Android VPN app that routes your traffic through your own Azure relay with TLS SNI set to look like Microsoft Teams — sign in with Microsoft and start the tunnel from the phone.
projects.overview: Flutter client provisions a VM in your Azure subscription, runs the hamieh relay, and uses Android VpnService + tun2socks so browsing goes through the tunnel. Fork of mission-sni-spoofing with on-device login instead of desktop CLI.
highlights: Android VPN app that routes your traffic through your own Azure relay with TLS SNI set to look like Microsoft Teams — sign in with Microsoft and start the tunnel from the phone.

projects.title: Khaybar News Bot
projects.description: Telegram-to-WhatsApp news bot — watches channels, filters posts with Gemini AI, translates to Arabic, and forwards text and media to a WhatsApp group.
projects.overview: Python bot using Telethon and Green API: urgency detection, bias filtering, media forwarding, and Docker/Railway deployment. Automates a news desk workflow end to end.
highlights: Telegram-to-WhatsApp news bot — watches channels, filters posts with Gemini AI, translates to Arabic, and forwards text and media to a WhatsApp group.

projects.title: RL Trading Agent
projects.description: Reinforcement-learning forex bot — trains an agent in a custom Gym environment to go long, short, or stay out using historical price windows.
projects.overview: RLTradingAgent includes trading_env.py (balance, commission, positions), training scripts, checkpoints, and evaluation plots. It simulates 0.01-lot trades and learns from market features over sliding windows.
highlights: Reinforcement-learning forex bot — trains an agent in a custom Gym environment to go long, short, or stay out using historical price windows.

projects.title: Data Cleaning Pipeline
projects.description: Data pipeline that turns raw spreadsheets into cleaned JSON and formatted Word reports with stats and loss summaries.
projects.overview: Python scripts extract, aggregate, and document structured datasets (including israel_losses workbooks) — export to DOCX/JSON for analysis and presentation.
highlights: Data pipeline that turns raw spreadsheets into cleaned JSON and formatted Word reports with stats and loss summaries.

projects.title: Hamieh Ads
projects.description: Flutter + Go tooling around WhatsApp automation and ad workflows — mobile UI with native bridges for messaging tasks.
projects.overview: Combines a Dart/Flutter front end with Go binaries (whatsapp.go, native libs) for Windows/Android builds. Built for campaign and messaging automation use cases.
highlights: Flutter + Go tooling around WhatsApp automation and ad workflows — mobile UI with native bridges for messaging tasks.
